svg.title: Calculate price strategies in ClickHouse SQL
svg.desc: One ready product expands to six price rows and then eighteen price/scenario cases. Each case is capped by stock before weighted sums return six price forecasts. Economics calculates sales, unsold units, revenue and costs. Window functions compare profit with unchanged pricing and identify the recommended price. No price is applied.

text.tspan: Calculate price strategies in ClickHouse SQL
Step 4 · Example: one product, six permitted prices, three demand scenarios.
All alternatives share the captured inputs. Results are forecasts; the query does not apply a price.
